messages.en: What are you doingg?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Did you see the street parade..?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
It was quite a unique experience.

messages.ko: 살다보니 홍대를 온 관심을 받으며 지나갈일이 생기는구나 하며뇨ㅓ
messages.en: I never thought there'd be a day I'd walk through Hongdae with everyone's attention on me.
Yesterday wasn't as cold as I expected.
But after midnight it did get a bit colder.
Dress warmly..
Just don't wear a Santa outfit.
Me? A Santa outfit?...
Try wearing one.
I want to see it.
Do I have to put on a beard too?
Well, at least it'd keep you warm.

messages.ko: 아니 며칠전부터 두바이 쫀득쿠키가 너무 먹고싶은거야
messages.en: Actually, for the past few days I've really been craving those Dubai chewy cookies.
So today I ordered three of them.
But I must've ordered from a bad place because they tasted awful.
My Dubai-cookie obsession has been cured.
You little pig.
Speaking of pigs...
Yubin-unnie and I are planning something.
An actual content series.
We go out to eat together a lot in our free time.

messages.ko: 하도 여기저기 많이 먹으러 다니고 많이 시키고 그러니까
messages.en: Since we're always eating at different places and ordering lots of food...
We've discovered so many good restaurants.

messages.ko: 이걸 컨텐츠로 찍었으면 이미100편은 나왔겠다 해서
messages.en: We figured if we'd been filming it, we'd already have over 100 episodes.
Yubin-unnie's a light eater, but she loves eating.
And I eat really well.

messages.ko: 항상 유진언니가 나랑 먹을때만 많이 잘먹는단 말이지
messages.en: Yujin-unnie always says she eats the most whenever she's eating with me.
Helping Gong Yubin increase her stomach capacity and stamina while touring great restaurants.
The title is... 'Pig Power.'
That's literally the name.
It'd be fun as a long-term series.
I even pitched it to the director. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Please make it happen.
What am I supposed to do when I love eating this much~
Before I became an idol...
Whenever I told my mom I wanted to become an idol...
"You won't be able to."
She'd say that.
"Whyyyy!!!!!!!"
"If you become an idol, you won't be able to eat much."
"Ah... then I guess I can't do it..."
That's what I said back then...
But somehow, I ended up becoming an idol.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Food vs me.
That's way too hard to choose.
So I turned **Y/n** into food.
So... I'm inside the fridge?
Yep.
My very own Dubai chewy cookie...
I thought you said your Dubai-cookie obsession was cured!
Oh!!
My very own... seafood...?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
That's a compliment, you know. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Just kidding.
There's only **Y/n**~
So after going around in circles, it still ends up being me... what a relief.
No.
It was you from the very beginning.
Hehe.
Tomorrow is the CSAT, right?
I wanted to experience the feeling of CSAT day.
It's a bit of a shame.
Good luck to everyone taking the CSAT tomorrow!
I hope you get a perfect score and make the news.
"This year's perfect CSAT scorer!!"
"Is it true that you guessed the questions you didn't know and still got them all right?"

messages.ko: 육각: 네.. 사실 수능전날 하연이랑 연락했습니다 혼자 행운을 다 가져가서 죄송합니다
messages.en: "Hexagon: Yes... Actually, I talked to Hayeon the day before the CSAT. I'm sorry for taking all the luck for myself."
"Isn't that cheating!!!"

messages.ko: 지나가면서 읽었던 문제들도 다 기억하는 마법
messages.en: A magic that lets you remember every question you glanced at in passing.
Ppyorororororong~
What if I only remember the questions?
I didn't think that far...
Then it's magic that lets you see all the answers!
Ppyaalaang~ Ppyong ppyong ppangssang!

messages.ko: 근데 왜 내 인생은 답이 안 보이냐
messages.en: Then why can't I see the answers to my life?
There isn't really such a thing as a correct answer in life.
Just be happy.
Seeing you makes me happy~
Then that's all that matters~
It's already the end of the year~~~
Time, please stop...
Can I age two more years so I'll be your age?
Sure... I'll give them to you...?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Wait a second.
I'm back.
Practice is about to start.
I'll probably stay busy until promotions are over.

messages.ko: 내가 연락 잘 못해도 속상해 하지마..
messages.en: Don't be sad even if I can't message you often...
I'll still come by often.
Even if it's only for a little while, I'll come see you.
I'm going to head out now.
Haranghae ❤️
